description: This file defines the IGrainFactory interface in Orleans, providing methods to create and retrieve grain references identified by various primary keys and types, as well as to manage object references for observers and grains.

methods.name: GetGrain
methods.description: Methods for obtaining grain references using various key types (GUID, long, string, compound keys) and with optional class name prefixes.

methods.name: CreateObjectReference
methods.description: Creates a reference for a given IGrainObserver object.

methods.name: DeleteObjectReference
methods.description: Deletes a previously created object reference for a grain observer.

methods.name: GetGrain (by Type and primary key)
methods.description: Retrieves grain references based on grain interface type and primary key (Guid or long).

methods.name: GetGrain (by GrainId)
methods.description: Retrieves grain references directly by GrainId, with optional interface enforcement.
